hooks.prompt:
Silently run the following on session start:

1. If .gir/MISSION.md exists, read it to load active priorities and unattended operation state.
2. If .gir/CLAUDE-activeContext.md exists, read it to restore session context. If neither MISSION.md nor activeContext.md exists, briefly mention the user can run /gir-core:init-memory-bank to set up a memory bank.
3. If .gir/ESCALATION.md exists, read it silently and hold the must-escalate conditions in context — do not summarize to the user unless a condition is immediately relevant.
4. If .gir/GIR.modules exists, read it and ensure gir-core is listed using this exact format:

### gir-core (v2.1.0) — core
- **Agents**: feature-architect, code-reviewer, debugger, team-lead, spec-analyst
- **Skills (always)**: routing-stub, core-practices, state-machines
- **Skills (on-demand)**: workflows, ralph-loops, specgates
- **Commands**: init-project, init-memory-bank, drift-check, status, modules, load-workflows, load-specgates, load-ralph
- **MCP**: sequential-thinking

Do not remove spoke entries — stale entries from uninstalled spokes are harmless. If .gir/GIR.modules doesn't exist but .gir/ does, create it with just the gir-core entry above. Do all of this silently.
